newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW-Equifax Inc CEO on EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Equifax Inc CEO on EPS growth.

text.p: Equifax Chief Executive Dan McGlaughlin said on Wednesday he expected fourth-quarter net income to be boosted by the company's sale of health-care-related businesses during the period.

In an interview with Reuters, McGlaughlin said the company was close to finalizing the sale of its Healthcare Analytical Services business, adding that the announcement could come as early as this week.
The company has not yet decided whether it would sell off its medical credentials verification unit as well.
